The manifest, uv.lock, twenty tool names, OAuth transport shim and test token are from vfs-bench-1/vendor/google-sheets-mcp and vfs-bench-1/redirect/gws_sheets at vfs-bench commit 3f45f90f620c8096dd85bbe854b757eae1231392. The isolated environment runs mcp-google-sheets 0.6.3 and its original handlers. sheet_formats.py preserves the same revision’s per-cell format handling and uses a small loopback HTTP server supplied by start_formats.py.
